calls.reason: The end-2026 deadline has not passed. The only evidence is an S&P capex projection covering six companies and 2027, which does not measure realized generative-AI spending through 2026.
'Going to be tough' is a hedged prediction with no deadline. NVIDIA's 10-Q shows contingent lease guarantees, but nothing shows whether raising the chip and construction money was hard or failed.

An NVIDIA case study reports DeepInfra's per-token cost falling in dollars on Blackwell. But that is the vendor's own report, nothing addresses profitability, and the claim is hedged with 'does not appear'.

A Bloomberg Opinion analysis from early July 2026 found SpaceX's BBB-rated bonds trading at wider average spreads (1.62pp) than BB junk bonds (1.55pp). That backs the main point even though the exact late-July figures are unverified.
